content.tagline: A Korean distributor of laboratory equipment
content.descriptor: Moz Science is a Korean distributor of laboratory equipment and solutions from Korean and international brands
about: We distribute laboratory equipment and research environment solutions in Korea. We serve biotechnology, life science, pharmaceutical and medical organisations, as well as research institutions.
According to Moz Science, we are an authorised Labconco distributor in Korea. This role is stated by the company in the materials supplied to Teranova.
formats: We support customers in Korea with equipment selection, technical consultation, supply, installation, initial setup, maintenance and after-sales technical support.
content.exportNote: The supply and services described here are for customers in Korea. Cooperation outside Korea is discussed separately through Teranova.

terms.label: Cooperation
terms.value: B2B enquiries and negotiations via Teranova.

content.consentNote: In correspondence dated 24 November 2026, Moz Science permitted the use, translation and publication of company and service information in its Teranova profile. This description is based on the company presentation supplied to Teranova; the Labconco distributor status is attributed to Moz Science.
